comments.author: Zezima
comments.body: Is this a rare equipment or it's a reward from a rare quest? Why people sell this 50M or 100M at bazzars?

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body: It is from an hard quest that may take up 100 QMP and you can obtain them once from this quest which is then unlikely to get another. Another reason is that this plays a big role at the Ranger job chain.
